sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: One of the twin beings born from the spirit of the grand deity that created life. Rinelle inherited the deity’s original qualities of compassion and calm demeanor. In her quest to save the deity from corruption, she traveled extensively across Seltavia’s landscape. In hopes of negating the contamination, she tested the purifying capabilities of pristine waters and life-brimming earth. However, nothing seemed to have any effect against the blight consuming the deity. Through this ordeal, Rinelle realized that to heal the deity, she must first cut off the very source of the corruption.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Night Angel Rinelle |bf2 = true }} '''Rinelle''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== One of the twin beings born from the spirit of the grand deity that created life. Rinelle inherited the deity’s original qualities of compassion and calm demeanor. In her quest to save the deity from corruption, she traveled extensively across Seltavia’s landscape. In hopes of negating the contamination, she tested the purifying capabilities of pristine waters and life-brimming earth. However, nothing seemed to have any effect against the blight consuming the deity. Through this ordeal, Rinelle realized that to heal the deity, she must first cut off the very source of the corruption. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Rinelle |element = Dark |image1 = Navi chara bf2 206 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 206 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 206 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 206 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 206 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 206 5.png |image6note = Hurt }} ==Trivia==
